title: Model index for the 2026-11-17 10:30 AM ET injury edition — what is filed, where each row came from, and what is missing
rule: Every row is either (a) printed as a named player/status in the 10:30 AM edition, (b) printed as 'NOT YET SUBMITTED', or (c) explicitly listed here as a gap. A gap is never filled by carrying a value forward silently.
narrative: The 10:30 AM edition's own text render carries 51 rows: 34 named rows across the five 11/17 game days (NYK@TOR 4, DET@SAS 11, POR@MIN 0 named + 2 NOT YET SUBMITTED, UTA@LAC 10, CHA@LAL 7 plus the detached Reaves row), 17 rows for 11/18 (13 matchups listed, all NOT YET SUBMITTED), and 1 torn fragment. The previous edition (11/16 01:30 PM) carried only the two-team 'NOT YET SUBMITTED' pillars for those same five 11/17 game days, which is 10 rows. So 24 named 11/17 players are newly printed in this edition and 0 previously-printed 11/17 players changed status or disappeared. The diff is reported that way rather than as '8 players removed', which was a defect of a matchup-only key (POR@MIN is played on both days).
